question: You plan to deploy three Azure virtual machines named VM1, VM2, and VM3. The virtual machines will host a web app named App1. You need to ensure that at least two virtual machines are available if a single Azure datacenter becomes unavailable. What should you deploy?

options.A: all three virtual machines in a single Availability Zone
options.B: all virtual machines in a single Availability Set
options.C: each virtual machine in a separate Availability Zone
options.D: each virtual machine in a separate Availability Set

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。一個可用性區域對應一或多個資料中心，全部放在同一區域時，該區域故障就會三台全滅。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。可用性設定組只在「單一資料中心內」跨機架分散，防護的是機架層級故障；整座資料中心不可用時同樣全部受影響。
explanations.C: Correct. 正確。可用性區域是同一 Azure 區域內彼此獨立的實體位置（各有獨立電力、冷卻與網路）。三台各放不同區域，任一資料中心故障時仍有兩台存活，符合需求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。把機器拆到不同的可用性設定組不但無法保證跨資料中心分散，還失去了設定組原本提供的 SLA。

question: You have an Azure virtual machine named VM1 that runs Windows Server 2019. You save VM1 as a template named Template1 to the Azure Resource Manager library. You plan to deploy a virtual machine named VM2 from Template1. What can you configure during the deployment of VM2?

options.C: virtual machine size

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。作業系統來自範本所擷取的映像，已經固定，部署時無法變更。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。以既有 VM 建立的範本部署時，系統管理員帳戶沿用原映像中的設定，不會在部署時要求重新指定。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。VM 大小已經寫在範本的資源定義中；若要改變必須先修改範本，而非在部署對話中選擇。
explanations.D: Correct. 正確。部署範本時一定要指定目標訂用帳戶與資源群組（可選既有或新建），這是每次部署都能自由決定的參數。

question: You have an Azure subscription that contains an Azure virtual machine named VM1. VM1 runs a financial reporting app named App1 that does not support multiple active instances. At the end of each month, CPU usage for VM1 peaks when App1 runs. You need to create a scheduled runbook to increase the processor performance of VM1 at the end of each month. What task should you include in the runbook?

options.A: Add the Azure Performance Diagnostics agent to VM1.
options.B: Modify the VM size property of VM1.
options.C: Add VM1 to a scale set.
options.D: Increase the vCPU quota for the subscription.
options.E: Add a Desired State Configuration (DSC) extension to VM1.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。效能診斷代理程式只收集診斷資料協助分析，不會提升任何運算效能。
explanations.B: Correct. 正確。App1 不支援多執行個體，因此無法用水平擴展解決，只能垂直擴充。Runbook 中修改 VM 大小屬性（換成更多 vCPU 的規格）即可提升處理器效能，月底過後也能再自動調回以節省成本。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。擴展集是靠增加執行個體來分攤負載，而 App1 明確不支援多個作用中執行個體。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。提高配額只是解除訂用帳戶的用量上限，並不會實際改變 VM1 的規格。
explanations.E: Incorrect. 錯誤。DSC 用於維持組態一致性，與運算效能無關。

question: You plan to deploy several Azure virtual machines that will run Windows Server 2019 in a virtual machine scale set by using an Azure Resource Manager template. You need to ensure that NGINX is available on all the virtual machines after they are deployed. What should you use?

options.A: Deployment Center in Azure App Service
options.C: the New-AzConfigurationAssignment cmdlet
options.D: a Microsoft Intune device configuration profile

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。部署中心屬於 App Service 的 CI/CD 功能，與虛擬機器擴展集無關。
explanations.B: Correct. 正確。DSC 延伸模組可以宣告式地描述機器應有的狀態（例如已安裝並啟動 NGINX），寫在擴展集範本的延伸模組設定中後，每個新佈建的執行個體都會自動套用。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。New-AzConfigurationAssignment 用於指派維護設定（維護時段），不會安裝軟體。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。Intune 管理的是使用者端點裝置，不用於 Azure IaaS 擴展集的軟體佈建。

question: You have an Azure virtual machine named VM1 that runs Windows Server 2019. The VM was deployed using default drive settings. You sign in to VM1 as a user named User1 and perform the following actions: ✑ Create files on drive C. ✑ Create files on drive D. ✑ Modify the screen saver timeout. ✑ Change the desktop background. You plan to redeploy VM1. Which changes will be lost after you redeploy VM1?

options.C: the new files on drive D
options.D: the new files on drive C

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。此設定寫在 OS 磁碟的登錄中，OS 磁碟會隨 VM 一起遷移，因此會保留。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。桌面背景同樣儲存在 OS 磁碟的使用者設定檔中，重新部署後仍存在。
explanations.C: Correct. 正確。以預設磁碟設定部署的 Windows VM，磁碟機 D 是「暫存磁碟」，資料存在本機主機的實體儲存體上。重新部署會把 VM 遷移到新主機，暫存磁碟隨之重建，D 槽上的檔案全部遺失。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。磁碟機 C 是持續性的 OS 受控磁碟，內容會完整保留。

question: You plan to back up an Azure virtual machine named VM1. You discover that the Backup Pre-Check status displays a status of Warning. What is a possible cause of the Warning status?

options.B: VM1 does not have the latest version of the Azure VM Agent (WaAppAgent.exe) installed.
options.C: VM1 has an unmanaged disk.
options.D: A Recovery Services vault is unavailable.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。已停止的 VM 仍可備份（只是取得的是檔案系統一致的備份），不會產生預先檢查警告。
explanations.B: Correct. 正確。備份預先檢查會檢驗 VM 是否具備成功備份的條件，最常見的警告原因就是 VM 代理程式版本過舊或未安裝，以及網路設定阻擋代理程式對外通訊——這類問題可修正，因此標示為「警告」而非「嚴重」。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。Azure 備份同時支援受控與未受控磁碟，磁碟類型本身不會觸發警告。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。若保存庫本身不可用，問題會表現為作業失敗，而不是預先檢查的警告狀態。

question: You plan to deploy several Azure virtual machines that will run Windows Server 2019 in a virtual machine scale set by using an Azure Resource Manager template. You need to ensure that NGINX is available on all the virtual machines after they are deployed. What should you use?

options.C: Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) Application Proxy

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。此 Cmdlet 用於指派維護設定，不會在機器上安裝軟體。
explanations.B: Correct. 正確。DSC 延伸模組可在擴展集範本中宣告每個執行個體應達到的狀態（安裝並執行 NGINX），新佈建的執行個體會自動套用。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。應用程式代理是把內部部署 Web 應用發佈到外部的反向代理服務，與 VM 軟體佈建無關。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。Application Insights 是應用程式效能監視服務，不負責安裝軟體。

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。換到 Cloud Shell 執行並不改變工具本身的能力；az aks 管理的是叢集層級作業，不能套用 YAML 資源清單。
explanations.B: Correct. 正確。無論在本機或 Cloud Shell，部署 YAML 都必須使用 kubectl（kubectl apply -f）；az aks 只負責建立、擴縮、升級叢集等管理動作。

question: Note: This question is part of a series of questions that present the same scenario. Each question in the series contains a unique solution that might meet the stated goals. You need to create an alert in Azure when more than two error events are logged to the System event log on VM1 within an hour. Solution: You create an Azure Log Analytics workspace and configure the data settings. You add the Microsoft Monitoring Agent VM extension to VM1. You create an alert in Azure Monitor and specify the Log Analytics workspace as the source. Does this meet the goal?

explanations.A: Correct. 【答案校正】官方標示為 B（否），但「Log Analytics 工作區 + MMA 代理程式 + 以工作區為來源的記錄警示」確實是可行且標準的做法。更關鍵的是本題庫的 id 323 解法幾乎完全相同（差別僅在「安裝 MMA」與「新增 MMA VM 延伸模組」的措辭），官方卻標示為 A（是）——兩者功能等價，官方標示自相矛盾，故本題判定為 A（是）。 正確。以 VM 延伸模組安裝 Microsoft Monitoring Agent，與手動安裝代理程式在功能上完全等價；資料同樣會流入 Log Analytics 工作區，再以工作區為來源建立記錄查詢警示即可達成目標。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。此路徑（工作區資料設定 + MMA 延伸模組 + 記錄查詢警示）可以正常運作。

question: You plan to deploy several Azure virtual machines that will run Windows Server 2019 in a virtual machine scale set by using an Azure Resource Manager template. You need to ensure that NGINX is available on all the virtual machines after they are deployed. What should you use?

options.C: Azure Custom Script Extension
options.D: a Microsoft Endpoint Manager device configuration profile

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。此 Cmdlet 只是把 DSC 組態封裝並上傳到儲存體，它本身不會把組態套用到擴展集的執行個體。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。Application Insights 是應用程式監視服務，不安裝軟體。
explanations.C: Correct. 正確。自訂指令碼延伸模組會在每個新佈建的執行個體上下載並執行指定的指令碼，用它執行安裝 NGINX 的指令即可；本題選項中沒有 DSC 延伸模組，自訂指令碼延伸模組是達成相同目的的標準方式。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。Endpoint Manager（Intune）管理的是使用者端點裝置，不用於 Azure 擴展集佈建。

question: You have an Azure subscription that contains three virtual machines named VM1, VM2, and VM3. All the virtual machines are in an availability set named AVSet1. You need to scale up VM1 to a new virtual machine size, but the intended size is unavailable. What should you do first?

options.C: Convert AvSet1 into a managed availability set.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。近似放置群組是為了降低執行個體之間的網路延遲，與能否取得某個 VM 大小無關。
explanations.B: Correct. 正確。目標大小無法使用，代表目前所在的叢集硬體不支援它。先解除配置 VM1 讓它脫離該叢集，Azure 就能在調整大小後把它配置到支援新規格的硬體上。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。受控可用性設定組指的是使用受控磁碟，與可用的 VM 大小無關。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。此選項本身有誤（重複列出 VM3）；而且若整組都必須釋出，正確做法是解除配置設定組中的所有 VM，而非只關閉其中兩台。

question: Note: This question is part of a series of questions that present the same scenario. Each question in the series contains a unique solution that might meet the stated goals. You receive an error message when you attempt to deploy a container instance by using image1. You need to be able to deploy a container instance by using image1. Solution: You set Admin user to Enable for Registry1. Does this meet the goal?

explanations.A: Correct. 正確。從容器登錄部署容器實例時必須提供登錄的認證。啟用管理員使用者會產生一組使用者名稱與密碼，容器實例即可用它來驗證並拉取 image1，解決原本的驗證失敗錯誤。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。啟用管理員使用者正是最直接可行的做法（雖然生產環境更建議改用服務主體或受控識別）。

question: You have an Azure AD tenant named contoso.com. You have an Azure subscription that contains an Azure App Service web app named App1 and an Azure key vault named KV1. KV1 contains a wildcard certificate for contoso.com. You have a user named [email protected] that is assigned the Owner role for App1 and KV1. You need to configure App1 to use the wildcard certificate of KV1. What should you do first?

options.A: Create an access policy for KV1 and assign the Microsoft Azure App Service principal to the policy.
options.B: Assign a managed user identity to App1.
options.C: Configure KV1 to use the role-based access control (RBAC) authorization system.
options.D: Create an access policy for KV1 and assign the policy to User1.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。授權給共用的 Microsoft Azure App Service 主體是較舊的做法，不是目前建議的第一步；現行做法是讓應用程式擁有自己的身分識別。
explanations.B: Correct. 正確。要讓 App1 自行從 KV1 取得憑證，必須先讓 App1 具備身分識別。指派受控識別後，才有對象可以在 KV1 上被授權讀取憑證與祕密。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。切換授權模式只是選擇用 RBAC 或存取原則來授權，本身並未賦予 App1 任何身分識別或權限。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。授權給使用者只讓「人」能讀取憑證，執行中的 App1 仍然無法自行取用。

question: You have an Azure subscription that contains a resource group named RG1. You plan to create a storage account named storage1. You have a Bicep file named File1. You need to modify File1 so that it can be used to automate the deployment of storage1 to RG1. Which property should you modify?

options.C: sku

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。kind 決定儲存體帳戶的種類（StorageV2、BlobStorage 等），與部署到哪個資源群組無關。
explanations.B: Correct. 正確。Bicep 以 targetScope／scope 決定部署的目標範圍。要把資源部署到特定資源群組，必須設定部署範圍指向 RG1。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。sku 指定的是效能與備援層級（例如 Standard_LRS），不影響部署目標。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。location 決定資源建立在哪個 Azure 區域，與資源群組的歸屬是不同的概念。

question: You have an Azure subscription that contains an Azure container registry named ContReg1. You enable the Admin user for ContReg1. Which username can you use to sign in to ContReg1?

options.C: administrator

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。root 是 Linux 系統的超級使用者，不是容器登錄的管理員帳戶名稱。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。ACR 的管理員帳戶名稱不是固定字串 admin。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。同樣不是 ACR 使用的名稱。
explanations.D: Correct. 正確。啟用管理員使用者後，其使用者名稱就是「登錄本身的名稱」（本題為 ContReg1），密碼則由 ACR 產生兩組可輪替的密碼。

question: You have an Azure subscription. You plan to create an Azure container registry named ContReg1. You need to ensure that you can push and pull signed images for ContReg1. What should you do for ContReg1?

options.A: Enable encryption by using a customer-managed key.
options.C: Add a token.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。客戶自控金鑰處理的是待用資料加密，與映像簽署驗證無關。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。連線的登錄用於邊緣或斷線環境的映像同步，不提供簽署功能。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。權杖用於範圍式的存取驗證，與映像簽章無關。
explanations.D: Correct. 正確。內容信任（基於 Docker Content Trust／Notary）啟用後即可推送與提取已簽署的映像，並在提取時驗證發行者簽章，確保映像未被篡改。此功能需要進階 SKU。

question: You plan to deploy several Azure virtual machines that will run Windows Server 2022 in a virtual machine scale set by using an Azure Resource Manager template. You need to ensure that NGINX is available on all the virtual machines after they are deployed. What should you use?

explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。此 Cmdlet 只負責把 DSC 組態封裝上傳到儲存體，本身不會把組態套用到執行個體。

question: You have an Azure subscription. You plan to deploy a container. You need to recommend which Azure services can scale the container automatically. What should you recommend?

options.C: Azure Container Apps or Azure App Service only
options.D: Azure Container Instances or Azure App Service only
options.E: Azure Container Apps, Azure Container Instances, or Azure App Service

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。Container Apps 確實支援自動調整，但 App Service 同樣具備自動調整能力，選項範圍不完整。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。Azure Container Instances 沒有內建的自動調整機制，需要外部邏輯自行增減容器群組。
explanations.C: Correct. 正確。Container Apps 以 KEDA 為基礎提供事件驅動的自動調整（可縮至零），App Service 也提供依計量或排程的自動調整；Container Instances 則不具備此能力。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。Container Instances 不支援自動調整。
explanations.E: Incorrect. 錯誤。同樣誤把 Container Instances 納入。

question: You have a Standard Azure App Service plan named Plan1. You need to ensure that Plan1 will scale automatically when the CPU usage of the web app exceeds 80 percent. What should you select for Plan1?

options.A: Automatic in the Scale out method settings
options.B: Rules Based in the Scale out method settings
options.C: Premium P1 in the Scale up (App Service plan) settings
options.D: Standard S1 in the Scale up (App Service plan) settings
options.E: Manual in the Scale out method settings

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。「自動」模式由平台自行決定執行個體數量，不接受你自訂的 CPU 閾值條件。
explanations.B: Correct. 正確。要依「CPU 超過 80%」這種自訂條件觸發調整，必須選擇規則式的向外擴增，並在其中建立以 CPU 百分比為計量的自動調整規則。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。升級到 Premium 只是提升方案層級與資源上限，本身不會建立任何自動調整規則。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。Standard S1 同樣只是規格選擇，與自動調整規則無關；而且方案已是標準層。
explanations.E: Incorrect. 錯誤。手動模式必須由人工設定固定的執行個體數，完全不會自動調整。

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。搬移訂用帳戶只改變資源的計費與管理歸屬，VM 仍執行在同一台實體主機上。
explanations.B: Correct. 正確。更換訂用帳戶不會遷移底層主機；要立即換主機必須使用「重新部署」。

question: Note: This question is part of a series of questions that present the same scenario. Each question in the series contains a unique solution that might meet the stated goals. explanations.A: Correct. 正確。「重新部署」會關閉 VM、把它遷移到 Azure 基礎結構中的新主機再開機，同時保留所有設定與關聯資源，正是為了規避主機層問題與維護而設計的功能。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。重新部署正是本情境的官方解法。

Does this meet the goal?

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。一次性更新是對客體作業系統安裝修補程式的作業，與 VM 執行在哪台實體主機無關。
explanations.B: Correct. 正確。安裝 OS 更新不會遷移 VM；要更換主機必須使用「重新部署」。

question: Your company has three offices. The offices are located in Miami, Los Angeles, and New York. Each office contains datacenter. You have an Azure subscription that contains resources in the East US and West US Azure regions. Each region contains a virtual network. The virtual networks are peered. You need to connect the datacenters to the subscription. The solution must minimize network latency between the datacenters. What should you create?

options.A: three Azure Application Gateways and one On-premises data gateway
options.B: three virtual hubs and one virtual WAN
options.C: three virtual WANs and one virtual hub
options.D: three On-premises data gateways and one Azure Application Gateway

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。應用程式閘道是第 7 層負載平衡器，內部部署資料閘道用於 Power BI／Logic Apps 等服務存取內部資料，兩者都不是站台互連方案。
explanations.B: Correct. 正確。Azure 虛擬 WAN 提供中樞輻射式的全球骨幹網路：建立「一個」虛擬 WAN 作為整體資源，再在各區域建立「虛擬中樞」讓辦公室就近連入。站台之間的流量走 Microsoft 骨幹傳輸，延遲最低。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。層級關係顛倒了——虛擬中樞是隸屬於虛擬 WAN 之下的資源，不會反過來由多個 WAN 共用一個中樞。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。這兩種閘道都不提供資料中心之間的網路互連能力。

question: You have an Azure subscription that contains a virtual network named VNet1. VNet1 contains four subnets named Gateway, Perimeter, NVA, and Production. The NVA subnet contains two network virtual appliances (NVAs) that will perform network traffic inspection between the Perimeter subnet and the Production subnet. You need to implement an Azure load balancer for the NVAs. The solution must meet the following requirements: ✑ The NVAs must run in an active-active configuration that uses automatic failover. ✑ The load balancer must load balance traffic to two services on the Production subnet. The services have different IP addresses. Which three actions should you perform? Each correct answer presents part of the solution. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.C: Add two load balancing rules that have HA Ports and Floating IP enabled
options.D: Add two load balancing rules that have HA Ports enabled and Floating IP disabled
options.E: Add a frontend IP configuration, a backend pool, and a health probe
options.F: Add a frontend IP configuration, two backend pools, and a health probe

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。HA 連接埠功能僅標準負載平衡器支援，基本負載平衡器無法滿足 NVA 主動－主動的需求。
explanations.B: Correct. 正確。HA 連接埠（一條規則涵蓋所有連接埠與通訊協定）是 NVA 情境的必要功能，而它只有標準負載平衡器提供。
explanations.C: Correct. 正確。NVA 檢查流量時必須看到「原始的目的 IP」，因此要啟用浮動 IP (Direct Server Return)；再加上 HA 連接埠讓所有連接埠的流量都能通過，兩條規則分別對應 Production 上那兩個不同 IP 的服務。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。停用浮動 IP 時封包的目的 IP 會被改寫為後端 NVA 的位址，NVA 便無法依原始目的地正確轉送與檢查流量。
explanations.E: Incorrect. 錯誤。題目明確指出要導向兩個「不同 IP」的服務，單一後端集區無法區分這兩個目標。
explanations.F: Correct. 正確。兩個後端集區分別對應 Production 上的兩個服務，搭配前端 IP 組態與健康情況探查，才能把流量分別導向不同 IP 的服務。

question: You have an Azure subscription named Subscription1 that contains two Azure virtual networks named VNet1 and VNet2. VNet1 contains a VPN gateway named VPNGW1 that uses static routing. There is a site-to-site VPN connection between your on-premises network and VNet1. On a computer named Client1 that runs Windows 10, you configure a point-to-site VPN connection to VNet1. You configure virtual network peering between VNet1 and VNet2. You verify that you can connect to VNet2 from the on-premises network. Client1 is unable to connect to VNet2. You need to ensure that you can connect Client1 to VNet2. What should you do?

options.A: Download and re-install the VPN client configuration package on Client1.
options.B: Select Allow gateway transit on VNet1.
options.C: Select Allow gateway transit on VNet2.

explanations.A: Correct. 正確。點對站用戶端的路由是在安裝組態套件時寫入的。新增對等互連之後，必須重新產生、下載並安裝用戶端組態套件，Client1 才會學到往 VNet2 的路由。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。站對站流量既然已經可以到達 VNet2，代表閘道傳輸相關設定本來就沒問題；這個設定不會更新已安裝的用戶端路由。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。「允許閘道傳輸」要勾在擁有閘道的那一端（VNet1），勾在 VNet2 上沒有意義。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。BGP 用於動態路由交換，對於「用戶端組態套件中的靜態路由未更新」這個問題並無幫助。

question: You have an Azure web app named webapp1. You have a virtual network named VNET1 and an Azure virtual machine named VM1 that hosts a MySQL database. VM1 connects to VNET1. You need to ensure that webapp1 can access the data hosted on VM1. What should you do?

options.B: Peer VNET1 to another virtual network
options.C: Connect webapp1 to VNET1

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。內部負載平衡器解決的是把流量分散到多個後端，而本題的問題是 App Service 與虛擬網路之間沒有連通路徑。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。對等互連是連接兩個虛擬網路；Web 應用程式並不在任何虛擬網路中，因此無法藉此取得存取權。
explanations.C: Correct. 正確。App Service 使用「虛擬網路整合」把 Web 應用程式的輸出流量帶進指定的虛擬網路，之後 webapp1 就能以私人 IP 存取同一網路中 VM1 上的 MySQL。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。應用程式閘道處理的是「輸入」流量的第 7 層負載平衡，本題需要的是 Web 應用程式的「輸出」連通性。

question: You have five Azure virtual machines that run Windows Server 2016. The virtual machines are configured as web servers. You have an Azure load balancer named LB1 that provides load balancing services for the virtual machines. You need to ensure that visitors are serviced by the same web server for each request. What should you configure?

options.A: Floating IP (direct server return) to Disabled
options.C: Floating IP (direct server return) to Enabled

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。浮動 IP 影響的是封包目的 IP 是否被保留，與同一用戶端是否固定導向同一後端無關。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。設為「無」時，負載平衡器會以五元組雜湊分配每個新連線，同一用戶端可能被導到不同伺服器，正好與需求相反。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。同 A，浮動 IP 不是工作階段黏著性的機制。
explanations.D: Correct. 正確。把工作階段持續性設為「用戶端 IP」（二元組雜湊）後，來自同一用戶端 IP 的所有連線都會被導向同一台後端伺服器，達成黏著工作階段。

question: Note: This question is part of a series of questions that present the same scenario. Each question in the series contains a unique solution that might meet the stated goals. Some question sets might have more than one correct solution, while others might not have a correct solution. After you answer a question in this section, you will NOT be able to return to it. As a result, these questions will not appear in the review screen. You have an Azure subscription that contains the following resources: ✑ A virtual network that has a subnet named Subnet1 ✑ Two network security groups (NSGs) named NSG-VM1 and NSG-Subnet1 ✑ A virtual machine named VM1 that has the required Windows Server configurations to allow Remote Desktop connections NSG-Subnet1 has the default inbound security rules only. NSG-VM1 has the default inbound security rules and the following custom inbound security rule: ✑ Priority: 100 ✑ Source: Any ✑ Source port range: * ✑ Destination: * ✑ Destination port range: 3389 ✑ Protocol: UDP ✑ Action: Allow VM1 has a public IP address and is connected to Subnet1. NSG-VM1 is associated to the network interface of VM1. NSG-Subnet1 is associated to Subnet1. You need to be able to establish Remote Desktop connections from the internet to VM1. Solution: You add an inbound security rule to NSG-Subnet1 that allows connections from the Any source to the *destination for port range 3389 and uses the TCP protocol. You remove NSG-VM1 from the network interface of VM1. Does this meet the goal?

explanations.A: Correct. 正確。遠端桌面使用 TCP 3389，而原本 NSG-VM1 上的自訂規則寫的是 UDP，因此會擋住連線。把 NSG-VM1 移除後只剩下 NSG-Subnet1，並在其中加入允許 TCP 3389 的規則，流量便能通行。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。這個組合同時解決了兩個問題：移除了以 UDP 誤設的 NSG，並在剩下的 NSG 上開放正確的 TCP 3389。

question: Note: This question is part of a series of questions that present the same scenario. Each question in the series contains a unique solution that might meet the stated goals. Some question sets might have more than one correct solution, while others might not have a correct solution. After you answer a question in this section, you will NOT be able to return to it. As a result, these questions will not appear in the review screen. You have an Azure subscription that contains the following resources: ✑ A virtual network that has a subnet named Subnet1 ✑ Two network security groups (NSGs) named NSG-VM1 and NSG-Subnet1 ✑ A virtual machine named VM1 that has the required Windows Server configurations to allow Remote Desktop connections NSG-Subnet1 has the default inbound security rules only. NSG-VM1 has the default inbound security rules and the following custom inbound security rule: ✑ Priority: 100 ✑ Source: Any ✑ Source port range: * ✑ Destination: * ✑ Destination port range: 3389 ✑ Protocol: UDP ✑ Action: Allow VM1 has a public IP address and is connected to Subnet1. NSG-VM1 is associated to the network interface of VM1. NSG-Subnet1 is associated to Subnet1. You need to be able to establish Remote Desktop connections from the internet to VM1. Solution: You add an inbound security rule to NSG-Subnet1 and NSG-VM1 that allows connections from the internet source to the VirtualNetwork destination for port range 3389 and uses the TCP protocol. Does this meet the goal?

explanations.A: Correct. 正確。流量必須同時通過子網路層與網路介面層的 NSG，因此兩個 NSG 都要放行。以 Internet 為來源、VirtualNetwork 為目的地並指定 TCP 3389，正確涵蓋了從網際網路連入 VM1 的路徑。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。兩層 NSG 都已加入正確的 TCP 規則，連線可以成功建立。

question: Your company has an Azure subscription named Subscription1. The company also has two on-premises servers named Server1 and Server2 that run Windows Server 2016. Server1 is configured as a DNS server that has a primary DNS zone named adatum.com. Adatum.com contains 1,000 DNS records. You manage Server1 and Subscription1 from Server2. Server2 has the following tools installed: ✑ The DNS Manager console ✑ Azure PowerShell ✑ Azure CLI 2.0 You need to move the adatum.com zone to an Azure DNS zone in Subscription1. The solution must minimize administrative effort. What should you use?

options.C: the Azure portal

explanations.A: Correct. 正確。Azure CLI 的 az network dns zone import 可以直接匯入 BIND 格式的區域檔案，一次把 1,000 筆記錄全部建立完成，管理工作最少。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。Azure PowerShell 沒有等同的區域檔案匯入指令，必須逐筆建立記錄集，工作量遠大於 CLI。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。入口網站只能手動一筆一筆新增記錄，1,000 筆完全不可行。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。DNS 管理員主控台管理的是 Windows DNS 伺服器，無法把區域寫入 Azure DNS。

question: You have a public load balancer that balances ports 80 and 443 across three virtual machines named VM1, VM2, and VM3. You need to direct all the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) connections to VM3 only. What should you configure?

options.B: a new public load balancer for VM3
options.C: a frontend IP configuration

explanations.A: Correct. 正確。輸入 NAT 規則會把前端某個連接埠的流量「一對一」轉送到指定的單一後端執行個體，正好用來把 RDP 只導向 VM3。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。多建一個負載平衡器是不必要的成本與複雜度，既有負載平衡器已能透過 NAT 規則達成。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。前端 IP 組態只是定義負載平衡器對外的位址，不決定流量送往哪一台後端。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。負載平衡規則的本質是把流量「分散」到後端集區中的多台機器，無法指定只送往單一 VM。
